patch_description: Replace the placeholder with a deterministic optimizer: start from a good heuristic spread of 11 points inside the equilateral triangle, then run a seeded random-restart local search (random perturbation of the currently best point, accepting only improvements to the minimum triangle area). All 165 triangle areas are computed vectorized with NumPy. Points are clipped to the triangle via barycentric coordinates to guarantee feasibility. This directly maximizes min_area_normalized while keeping eval_time small and results reproducible.
